_comment: SHA-256 integrity manifest for ML models (security control H-08/H-12). Maps each model's path (relative to BULWARK_ML_MODEL_DIR) to its trusted SHA-256. The ONNX loader (src/scanners/ml/model_manager.py) fails closed if a model is missing from this manifest or its hash does not match. Regenerate/verify with: python scripts/download-models.py --injection
